§6Servos§f

§aPull items and fluids from blocks into duct networks, the engine that makes everything move!§f

§bServos§f attach to fluiduct and itemduct connections, extracting from the adjacent block into the duct.

§6Tiers§f:
§b• Basic§f: §e3s§f delay, §e8× stack§f, §e50%§f fluid, §e3 slots§f.
§b• Hardened§f: §e2s§f, §e16× stack§f, §e75%§f, §e6 slots§f.
§b• Reinforced§f: §e1s§f, §e32× stack§f, §e100%§f, §e9 slots§f.
§b• Signalum§f: §e0.5s§f, §e64× stack§f, §e2× speed§f, §e150%§f, §e12 slots§f.
§b• Resonant§f: §e0.5s§f, §e64× stack§f, §e3× speed§f, §e200%§f, §e15 slots§f.

Filter modes: Blacklist/Whitelist, Metadata, NBT, Ore Dictionary, Mod Owner (tier-dependent). Routing modes (Reinforced+): Nearest, Furthest, Random, Round Robin.

§eNote§f: Servos need a redstone signal by default (High mode). Configurable per-servo.
